content_sections.heading: ESIC Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the ESIC Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download ESIC Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: ESIC Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 31 vacancies are available - 12 for Professor, 12 for Associate Professor, and 7 for Assistant Professor.

content_sections.heading: ESIC Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Professor: As per latest NMC (MCI) notifications Associate Professor: As per latest NMC (MCI) notifications Assistant Professor: As per latest NMC (MCI) notifications

content_sections.heading: ESIC Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit
content_sections.text: Maximum Age Limit: 67 years for all posts. Candidates should ensure that they meet the prescribed age limit as on the specified cut-off date. You can use our Age Calculator to check your exact age and confirm your eligibility before applying.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for ESIC Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for ESIC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for ESIC Teaching Faculty posts is scheduled for 23 September 2026. Candidates should ensure they reach the venue on this date.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Teaching Faculty posts at ESIC?
faq.answer: There are a total of 31 vacancies for Teaching Faculty positions, including Professor, Associate Professor, and Assistant Professor posts.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this ESIC recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview directly with their documents.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for the Teaching Faculty posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all Teaching Faculty posts is 67 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Assistant Professor post?
faq.answer: The salary offered for the Assistant Professor post is Rs. 1,48,263/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. Are there any application fees for SC/ST and Women candidates?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for SC/ST and Women candidates for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the qualification required for the Teaching Faculty posts?
faq.answer: The qualification required for the Teaching Faculty posts is as per the latest NMC (MCI) notifications.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should candidates carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies, ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates, and category certificates if applicable.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for ESIC Teaching Faculty recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for this recruitment is based on an Interview.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the ESIC Medical College & Hospital located?
faq.answer: ESIC Medical College & Hospital is located in Basaidarapur, New Delhi, with the pincode 110015.
